name: reach-run-of-ten
description: Plans one small run of about ten people for this week, with the time block in your calendar, one reason and one status per person about your own actions, what is ready and what waits, and the next run's start date. Use for "run reach-run-of-ten", "run of ten plan", "plan my outreach week", "weekly outreach plan", "who do I write to this week", "prospecting routine", "ten messages a week", "outreach in small batches", part of the Claude Guide for Outreach Pack by 90n.
